text_blocks.snippet: During the COVID-19 pandemic, AstraZeneca focused on developing, manufacturing, and supplying its COVID-19 vaccine. They partnered with others to establish over 25 supply networks across 15 countries, delivering two billion vaccine doses. It's estimated that the vaccine helped save six million lives in its first year. Additionally, AstraZeneca's vaccine played a role in scientific understanding of rare blood clotting events associated with some viral vector vaccines.
